title: How to Master the Bias-Variance Tradeoff in Machine Learning Models

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we've got a very exciting tutorial, the bias-variance tradeoff.
cues.zh: 今天有堂很精彩的教學，偏差與變異的權衡。

cues.en: All right, so to operate with these terms, let's first define them.
cues.zh: 要使用這些術語，先定義它們。

cues.en: Bias is a systematic error that occurs in the machine learning model itself due to incorrect assumptions in the machine learning process.
cues.zh: 偏差，是機器學習過程中不正確的假設，導致模型本身產生的系統性誤差。

cues.en: Technically, it can be thought of as the error between the average model prediction and the ground truth.
cues.zh: 技術上，可以想成平均模型預測與真實答案之間的誤差。

cues.en: Whereas variance is how much the model can adjust depending on the given data set.
cues.zh: 變異則是模型隨資料集改變而調整的程度。

cues.en: Variance refers to changes in the model when using different portions of the training data set.
cues.zh: 也就是使用不同部分訓練資料時，模型發生的變化。

cues.en: Now, let's visualize this to better understand it.
cues.zh: 現在用視覺化幫助理解。

cues.en: But first, we're going to refer to something we discussed previously, which is K-fold cross-validation.
cues.zh: 但先回顧之前討論的 k 折交叉驗證。

cues.en: So in K-fold cross-validation, we've got these metrics.
cues.zh: 交叉驗證會得到這些指標。

cues.en: So we split our set, we've got our training set, then the training set was split into 10 folds.
cues.zh: 先切分資料，再把訓練集分為 10 折。

cues.en: And so then, we train the model on these nine folds combined and we validate it or do tests on this one leftover fold.
cues.zh: 用這 9 折一起訓練，再對剩餘 1 折驗證或測試。

cues.en: Then, we train the model on these nine folds, and then we test it on this one fold, and so on.
cues.zh: 接著換成這 9 折訓練，再用這 1 折測試，以此類推。

cues.en: And so, the result were slightly changing the training data just a little bit every time, and we're validating or testing the resulting model
cues.zh: 因此每次訓練資料稍微改變，再用訓練時沒看過的資料，驗證或測試

cues.en: on data that wasn't seen during training.
cues.zh: 產生的模型。

cues.en: And so, we're getting these sets of metrics, and in case of tenfold cross validation, we have 10 metrics.
cues.zh: 由此得到多組指標，10 折交叉驗證就有 10 組。

cues.en: Now, if we plot this on the bias-variance curve, or like metaphorically speaking, in the top left corner, we'll have high bias, low variance.
cues.zh: 如果將情況畫在偏差與變異圖上，或者說用比喻，左上角是高偏差、低變異。

cues.en: So this is what happens when you have high bias, low variance.
cues.zh: 高偏差、低變異會出現這種情況。

cues.en: This is what you want to predict, this is the target, but your model is all of those predictions of all those models that we just looked at.
cues.zh: 這是希望預測的目標，而模型的預測，就是剛才那些模型產生的全部點。

cues.en: They are far away from the target, but they're clustered together, right?
cues.zh: 它們離目標很遠，但彼此聚在一起，對吧？

cues.en: And what does that mean?
cues.zh: 這表示什麼？

cues.en: Well, that means that the model is too simple and does not capture the underlying trend of the data, so it's far away from the target, but at the same time, they're clustered.
cues.zh: 模型太簡單，沒捕捉到底層資料趨勢，所以遠離目標，但預測彼此集中。

cues.en: On the other hand, you might have this situation where you have low bias and high variance where the average of all of these models is on the target,
cues.zh: 另一種情況是低偏差、高變異，這些模型的平均落在目標上，

cues.en: but at the same time, as you can see, every time we change the underlying trained data slightly, the model result is different or it varies.
cues.zh: 但可以看到，每次底層訓練資料稍變，模型結果就不同，或者說變動很大。

cues.en: And that's low bias, high variance, and it means that the model is too sensitive and is capturing noise as if it were a real trend, it's overfitting to our data.
cues.zh: 這就是低偏差、高變異，表示模型太敏感，把雜訊當成真實趨勢，對資料過度擬合。

cues.en: And both of these scenarios, as you can imagine, are bad.
cues.zh: 可以想像，這兩種情況都不好。

cues.en: So in this case, we are away from the target, in this case, we're overfitting to the data.
cues.zh: 一種遠離目標，另一種過度擬合資料。

cues.en: And of course, you can also have a scenario like this where you have high bias and high variance, so the average of these predictions is somewhere here, which is also away from where we want it to be,
cues.zh: 當然也可能是高偏差、高變異，預測平均在這裡，離目標很遠，

cues.en: and they're also scattered across.
cues.zh: 而且也四處分散。

cues.en: And this is the probably the worst of the three, and here, the model is too simple to capture the data's trend and it's too sensitive, it captures noise as well.
cues.zh: 這可能是三種裡最糟的，模型太簡單、捕捉不到趨勢，同時又太敏感，把雜訊也捕捉進來。

cues.en: So those are the three kind of non-ideal scenarios, and here's the ideal scenario, which is kind of like the unicorn where your data is clustered together,
cues.zh: 這是三種不理想情況；理想情況像這樣，猶如難得一見的獨角獸，預測聚在一起，

cues.en: so you have low variance and it's in the right spot around.
cues.zh: 變異低，而且在正確位置附近。

cues.en: So the average is the average that we want, actually, we're aiming to predict, so therefore it's got low bias.
cues.zh: 平均就是我們想預測的目標，所以偏差也低。

cues.en: And this is a great model, it accurately captures the underlying trends of the data and generalizes well to unseen data.
cues.zh: 這是很好的模型，準確捕捉底層趨勢，也能泛化到未見過的資料。

cues.en: Now, the thing is that this is very rare and it's kind of like a unicorn to catch this kind of scenario.
cues.zh: 但這很少見，就像找到獨角獸一樣。

cues.en: Most of the times, you'll be trading off between this and this.
cues.zh: 大多數時候，需要在這兩者之間權衡。

cues.en: So if you make your model very sophisticated, then you will indeed get a very good average score, you'll be very close to what you're predicting,
cues.zh: 模型非常複雜時，平均結果確實可能很好，非常接近預測目標，

cues.en: but you'll be capturing noise and data.
cues.zh: 但也會捕捉資料雜訊。

cues.en: And as soon as the data changes slightly, your model predictions will be off, so it's not a good model in that sense.
cues.zh: 資料一有小變化，預測就偏離，所以這個意義上不是好模型。

cues.en: Or if you make it less complex, so if your model's super sophisticated, it'll be here, if it's less sophisticated, it'll end up here where it's too simple to even capture this,
cues.zh: 如果降低複雜度，原本複雜模型在這裡，較簡單的可能到這裡，簡單得連趨勢都捕捉不到，

cues.en: like all the predictions will be close to each other, but it's too simple to capture the target.
cues.zh: 預測彼此相近，但模型太簡單，無法掌握目標。

cues.en: And so, you'll have to be trading off between these two, making either simpler or more complex and finding your middle ground somewhere between them and aiming to be as close as possible to this scenario.
cues.zh: 因此需要在兩者間權衡，調簡單或複雜，找中間位置，並盡量接近理想情況。

cues.en: So that's how the bias-variance tradeoff works, and that's how we can combine it with K-fold cross-validation to assess and understand our models better.
cues.zh: 這就是偏差與變異權衡，也能結合 k 折交叉驗證，更好地評估與理解模型。

cues.en: On that note, I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂課見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
